function captionAt(t){for(let i=0;i<cues.length;i++){if(t>=cues[i][0]&&t<cues[i][1])return cues[i][2]}return ''}
function drawCaption(t){let s=captionAt(t);if(!s)return;let lines=s.split('\n');let h=lines.length===1?68:lines.length===2?92:112;let y=H-42-h;ctx.save();ctx.globalAlpha=.96;shadow();rr(300,y,1320,h,18,'rgba(255,255,255,.94)','rgba(255,255,255,.96)',2);noShadow();lines.forEach((l,i)=>txt(l,960,y+h/2+(i-(lines.length-1)/2)*30,25,C.teal,680,'center'));ctx.restore()}
function getScene(t){if(t<11.3673)return ['01 / Search visibility',drawScene1];if(t<30.8267)return ['02 / Brand introduction',drawScene2];if(t<69.3600)return ['03 / SEO capabilities',drawScene3];if(t<93.4433)return ['04 / Proven process',drawScene4];if(t<127.1600)return ['05 / Performance proof',drawScene5];return ['06 / Strong CTA',drawScene6]}
function render(t){t=clamp(t,0,DURATION);background(t);let [label,fn]=getScene(t);sceneLabel.textContent=label;fn(t);drawCaption(t);
  // restrained frame marker and brand signature
  ctx.save();ctx.globalAlpha=.42;rr(1690,52,150,48,24,'rgba(255,255,255,.55)','rgba(0,64,72,.08)',1);txt('SEO / 2026',1765,76,13,C.teal,800,'center');ctx.restore();
  seek.value=t;document.getElementById('currentTime').textContent=fmt(t);document.getElementById('totalTime').textContent=fmt(voice.duration||DURATION);
}
function fmt(s){s=Math.max(0,Math.floor(s||0));return String(Math.floor(s/60)).padStart(2,'0')+':'+String(s%60).padStart(2,'0')}
function now(){return voice.src?voice.currentTime:manualTime}
function frame(ts){if(!playing)return;if(!voice.src){if(!lastTick)lastTick=ts;manualTime+=(ts-lastTick)/1000;lastTick=ts;if(manualTime>=DURATION){manualTime=DURATION;pause()}}let t=now();render(t);raf=requestAnimationFrame(frame)}
function play(){if(playing)return;playing=true;playBtn.textContent='Ⅱ Pause';lastTick=0;if(voice.src){voice.play().catch(e=>{status.innerHTML='<strong>Audio could not play.</strong> Check the selected audio file and browser permission.'})}raf=requestAnimationFrame(frame)}
function pause(){playing=false;playBtn.textContent='▶ Play preview';if(voice.src)voice.pause();cancelAnimationFrame(raf);render(now())}
playBtn.addEventListener('click',()=>playing?pause():play());
document.getElementById('restartBtn').addEventListener('click',()=>{pause();manualTime=0;if(voice.src)voice.currentTime=0;render(0)});
seek.addEventListener('input',()=>{let v=+seek.value;if(voice.src)voice.currentTime=v;else manualTime=v;render(v)});
document.getElementById('audioInput').addEventListener('change',e=>{let f=e.target.files&&e.target.files[0];if(!f)return;pause();if(audioUrl)URL.revokeObjectURL(audioUrl);audioUrl=URL.createObjectURL(f);voice.src=audioUrl;voice.load();voice.onloadedmetadata=()=>{let d=voice.duration||DURATION;audioMeta.textContent=f.name+' · '+fmt(d);seek.max=d;document.getElementById('totalTime').textContent=fmt(d);status.innerHTML='<strong>Voiceover loaded.</strong> Press Play to preview the animation with your audio. Subtitle timings are aligned to the embedded 2:48 voiceover.';render(0)};});
voice.addEventListener('ended',()=>{pause()});
document.getElementById('fullscreenBtn').addEventListener('click',()=>{let el=document.getElementById('stageWrap');if(el.requestFullscreen)el.requestFullscreen()});
function getMime(){let opts=['video/mp4;codecs=h264,aac','video/webm;codecs=vp9,opus','video/webm;codecs=vp8,opus','video/webm'];return opts.find(x=>window.MediaRecorder&&MediaRecorder.isTypeSupported(x))||''}
document.getElementById('recordBtn').addEventListener('click',()=>{
 if(!window.MediaRecorder||!canvas.captureStream){status.innerHTML='<strong>Recording is not supported in this browser.</strong> Use Chrome or Edge desktop.';return}
 if(voice.src&&voice.paused&&voice.currentTime>0&&voice.currentTime<(voice.duration||DURATION)){status.innerHTML='<strong>Ready to record.</strong> Press Play after starting the recording.'}
 const mime=getMime();if(!mime){status.innerHTML='<strong>No supported recorder format found.</strong>';return}
 stream=canvas.captureStream(60);if(voice.src&&voice.captureStream){let as=voice.captureStream();as.getAudioTracks().forEach(track=>stream.addTrack(track))}
 recChunks=[];try{recorder=new MediaRecorder(stream,{mimeType:mime,videoBitsPerSecond:16000000,audioBitsPerSecond:192000})}catch(err){recorder=new MediaRecorder(stream)}
 recorder.ondataavailable=e=>{if(e.data&&e.data.size)recChunks.push(e.data)};
 recorder.onstop=()=>{let blob=new Blob(recChunks,{type:recorder.mimeType||mime});let ext=blob.type.includes('mp4')?'mp4':'webm';let url=URL.createObjectURL(blob);let a=document.createElement('a');a.href=url;a.download='digital-world-agency-seo-motion.'+ext;a.click();setTimeout(()=>URL.revokeObjectURL(url),10000);if(stream)stream.getTracks().forEach(t=>t.stop());status.innerHTML='<strong>Recording saved.</strong> Your '+ext.toUpperCase()+' file has been downloaded.'};
 recorder.start(1000);recording=true;document.getElementById('recordBtn').disabled=true;document.getElementById('stopRecordBtn').disabled=false;status.innerHTML='<strong>Recording started.</strong> Press Play now; keep this tab active and let the timeline reach the end, then select Stop & save.';
});
document.getElementById('stopRecordBtn').addEventListener('click',()=>{if(recorder&&recorder.state!=='inactive')recorder.stop();recording=false;document.getElementById('recordBtn').disabled=false;document.getElementById('stopRecordBtn').disabled=true;pause()});
voice.addEventListener('loadedmetadata',()=>{
 const d=voice.duration||DURATION;
 seek.max=d;
 audioMeta.textContent='Embedded Cartesia voiceover · '+fmt(d);
 document.getElementById('totalTime').textContent=fmt(d);
 status.innerHTML='<strong>Voiceover ready.</strong> Press Play preview to start the narration and synchronized motion graphics.';
 render(now());
});

 status.innerHTML='<strong>Audio could not be loaded.</strong> Try opening this HTML file in the latest Chrome or Edge browser.';
});
render(0);
})();
